test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statements and decide which of the assumptions from the options is NOT implicit in the statements.

All birds are wings.

Some wings are feathers.

Some feathers are birds.

options.text: Some birds are wings and feathers.

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3d91ca12a16ea67c20b75daef6f50e3b85f3bc8b54782fed95ebf42c690a0f2.png] 

i) Some birds are feathers. **→ **True

ii) All wings are birds. **→ **False (as it is possible but not definite)

iii) Some birds are wings and feathers. **→** True

iv) Some feathers are wings. **→ **True

Hence, 'All wings are birds.' is NOT implicit in the statements.
